live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#732; borg-reborn-rs #1098, PR #1117, the second mode of #1080). Six arms on 3a2d2215 (explore_mixed compiled and shipped 0; track-p 8e1c8797 with PR #1117): ctl (shipped, breadth-first on); mixed (explore_mixed 1, the full ladder breadth-first then mixed); nobfs (explore_breadth_first 0, the control for mixed-alone); mixed-alone (explore_mixed 1 and explore_breadth_first 0); mixed-tight (explore_mixed 1, explore_mix_contact_damage 8); mixed-loose (explore_mixed 1, explore_mix_contact_damage 3). Tiers one at a time on the one specimen: pilot, then verysmall (classes-1800 starts 1-45), then small-rest (46-90), each on the owner's word; if capacity is short, ctl and mixed first. The mode applies above the breadth-first threshold, where C's exploring leash applies; the owner expects survivability to rise sharply at CL5-6, so it may not pay for itself. Requester's local direction on the 20 level-1 death starts: ctl against mixed 0 deaths against 0, 13 plays identical, 7 split, mean CL 4.95 against 4.90, DL3 reached by 2 against 1.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen 3a2d2215. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report: all deaths and deaths at CL3-8 (the band this mode is for), paired by start (ctl against each arm; mixed-alone against nobfs), exact McNemar; the cost: CL at 25k / 50k / 100k turns, starts reaching DL3 and DL5 and their first turn there; deaths per 10,000 turns at each (CL, DL) from #718's turns_at_level_depth; a death report with screens (/death-report) for deaths in mixed or ctl. Descriptive (RULES 14).
